proves.claim: The request pullboard serve hands the board API for a landed tip runs the project's gate command whole at that tip through testJobEntry with GATE_NEEDS and the gate bootstrap.

cli.test.post-land.request-runs-gate.why: The board API cannot build a runnable test job alone; without this request the post-land job has nothing to run.

proves.claim: A project whose pullboard.json names no gate command gets no post-land request, so no job is queued.

cli.test.post-land.no-gate-no-job.why: A job with no command would run nothing and post a meaningless receipt.
